evidence.name: Screen Editor: Text Field
evidence.userNeed: Know what the Text Field section controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Text Field section
sections.description: The Text Field section turns a screen into a question that collects a free-text answer such as a name, email, or goal. Set the placeholder hint, validation, and styling here; the answer is saved in a variable you can later use to branch the flow or personalize copy. Use it whenever the visitor should type an answer rather than pick from options — that captured input is what makes the screen gather usable data.
